title: Long-Lead Fixture Decision Deadline
dataSources: Renovation tasks (`reno:task`), budget and receipts (`reno:budget`), material orders (`reno:material`), inspections (`reno:inspection`), contractor logs (`reno:contractor`).
app: Home-renovation project management — task boards (Trello, Notion), budget and receipt trackers, material orders, and inspection / permit logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=reno:material decision_due_epoch=*
| eval days_to_decision=round((decision_due_epoch-now())/86400,1)
| where ordered!="yes"
| sort days_to_decision
description: Lists fixtures or finishes whose selection deadline is approaching before procurement lead times become a risk.
value: Design indecision becomes schedule damage when long-lead items miss their ordering window.
implementation: Capture decision deadlines on long-lead items and sort unapproved fixtures by days remaining.
visualization: Table of long-lead fixtures by decision deadline.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks which big fixtures need a decision soon so the project does not stall waiting for them.
